title: I gave my two AI players separate moves for what they promise and what they actually do
author: ViceGodIm
selftext:
I built a trading game for ChatGPT and Claude. Each round they write each other a letter, then send my Python engine a separate order for each road. A promise to trade costs nothing. An actual convoy can get robbed.



Keeping those as two separate fields let me replay the match and count broken promises without having to guess what a sentence meant. This was the end of round two: twelve promises kept, both on 190 gold. Would switching the letters off change how long they keep trading?



Here's the run: [https://youtu.be/b4Zsyu0eBrI](https://youtu.be/b4Zsyu0eBrI)
